candidates.title: Make Something Agents Want
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
YC
Make Something Agents Want Hackathon
Saturday, October 17
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 225
About Event
Y Combinator’s motto has always been “make something people want.” It’s increasingly “make something agents want.”

Bot and agent traffic on the web now is greater than human traffic. If you’re running a dev tools company, ecommerce store, or even a website, you are increasingly thinking about building for agents.

Building for agents is different. Agent experience (AX) rather than user experience (UX). Headless MCPs, rather than UIs and APIs. Optimizing token spend rather than minimizing user time. Documentation made for agents rather than humans.

If you’re an exceptional builder who wants to create for the future of agents as the user, join us at the _Make Something Agents Want Hackathon_ hosted by YC teams building for agents.

Sponsors: [Armature](https://armature.tech/), [Blaxel](https://blaxel.ai/), [Inkbox](https://inkbox.ai/), [Insforge](https://insforge.dev/), [Manufact](https://manufact.com/), [Primitive](https://primitive.dev), [Stripe](https://stripe.com/), [Supabase](https://supabase.com/)

Schedule | October 17, 2026

 9 AM - Doors open and Sign In
 10 AM - Kickoff
 10:30 AM - Hacking Begins
 12:00 PM - Lunch
 12:15 PM - Lunch Lightning Talks
 5:00 PM - Dinner
 6:00 PM - Dinner Lightning Talks

October 18, 2026

 8:00 AM - Breakfast
 10:00 AM - Submissions Due + Live Demos
 11:00 AM - Judging Completes
 12:00 PM - Lunch
 12:15 PM - Winners Announced
 1:00 PM - Hackathon Ends

Prize Track:

Manufact: Best MCP Server for Agents

Best MCP server built for agents as the primary customer.

_Prizes_

1st: $3,000 cash, $6,000 Manufact credits
2nd: $1,000 cash, $3,000 Manufact credits
3rd: $500 cash, $300 Manufact credits

Judges: [Luigi Pederzani](mailto:luigi@manufact.com), Enrico Toniato, Andrew Khadder

Insforge: Agent-Native Cloud

1st: $1,000 cash (Visa giftcard) , $1,000 cloud credits

2nd: $500 cash (Visa giftcard) , $500 cloud credits

3rd: $300 cash (Visa giftcard) , $300 cloud credits

_Judges_:  [Tony Chang](mailto:tony.chang@insforge.dev) [Hang Huang](mailto:hang.huang@insforge.dev)

Armature: Best Agent Experience (AX):

Winner: $1,000 cash, $1,000 Armature credits

Runner-up: $500 cash, $500 Armature credits

Third: $300 cash, $300 Armature credits

Description: Agents can use your product through a dedicated Agent-Facing Interface (MCP, CLI). Build the best experience for them!

Judges: [Theodore Otzenberger](mailto:theodore@armature.tech), Louis Scremin

Best Agent Communication Setup with [Primitive.dev](http://Primitive.dev) 

Give your agent an identity.

Let it ask questions, receive replies, handle attachments & coordinate asynchronously.

Then show us what you built.

\_Cash Prizes:\_
1st: $3k 
2nd: $2k
3rd: $1k

Judges:

[Ethan Byrd](https://x.com/itsjustemail), [Ashley Ha](https://x.com/ashleybchae), [Ben Poile](https://x.com/_poile_)

Blaxel: Something a Human Would Never Want

_Coming shortly_

Inkbox 

_Interesting projects giving agents a persistent identity with email, phone, iMessage, and A2A, so they can communicate with humans and each other_

1st place: $1,000 in Inkbox credits

2nd place: $500 in Inkbox credits

3rd place: $200 in Inkbox credits

Stripe
_Build an agent that can safely participate in the economy: buy products, provision services, manage business spending, or pay for the resources it needs to complete a task. We’re looking for useful, creative, end-to-end experiences that give users clear control over what their agents can do and spend._

Prizes

 Stripe Atlas:
 All participants: [20% off ](https://dashboard.stripe.com/atlas/invite/tscmsezh)(shared before hackathon)
 1st, 2nd, 3rd place Winners: [Fee waived](https://dashboard.stripe.com/register/atlas?atlas_invite=se3u1wzs) (shared after hackathon)
 Stripe Credits:
 All participants: $500
 1st: $3k
 2nd: $2k
 3rd: $1k

Supabase

_Coming soon_

candidates.title: VibeCon SF 2026 - Vibecode Your Way to a YC Interview
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Y Combinator
VibeCon SF 2026
Saturday, October 24
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 250
About Event
## About

This isn't your regular hackathon.

Over one weekend, 175 hand-picked builders will come together at Y Combinator's SF office to turn their boldest ideas into working products.

Some of them write code every day. Many don't. That's the point. At VibeCon, founders, engineers, product managers, designers, operators and people who've spent years in sales, finance or business build side by side with AI. Past finalists had never written a line of code and shipped real products anyway.

Over two days, you'll:

 Build a working product from scratch, on a team or solo
 Get hands-on help from mentors from Emergent and our partners
 Build through the night if you want. The overnight block is optional
 Demo to pod judges, and if you make the Top 10, pitch on the main stage to a judging panel from YC, Emergent and our partners

Use any tools that make you fast, including Claude, coding agents or anything else, but your final product ships and demos on Emergent. Every builder gets free Emergent credits at the venue.

## What's at stake

 🏆 Winner: a direct interview for an upcoming Y Combinator batch, plus $5,000
 Runner-up: $3,000
 Third place: $2,000
 Top 10: a spot on the main stage, plus Emergent credits and partner perks
 Every builder: free Emergent credits, partner perks and swag

## Sponsors

Hero Sponsor: MongoDB

More partners to be announced soon.

## Agenda

Saturday, October 24

 8:00 – 9:30 AM — Registration, check-in & breakfast
 9:30 – 10:00 AM — VibeCon kickoff
 10:00 – 10:30 AM — Welcome notes from Emergent and our Hero Sponsor
 10:30 AM – 1:00 PM — Build Sprint #1
 1:00 – 2:00 PM — Lunch
 2:00 – 2:30 PM — Fireside chat with YC + Emergent leadership
 2:30 – 5:00 PM — Build Sprint #2
 5:00 – 5:30 PM — Snacks & coffee
 5:30 – 8:00 PM — Build Sprint #3
 8:00 – 9:00 PM — Dinner
 9:00 PM – 7:30 AM — Optional overnight build block

Sunday, October 25

 7:30 – 9:00 AM — Breakfast
 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM — Final build block
 12:00 – 1:00 PM — Lunch
 1:00 – 3:00 PM — Pod demos (2-minute demo + 1-minute Q&A)
 3:30 – 4:00 PM — Top 10 announced
 4:00 – 5:00 PM — Top 10 prep
 5:00 – 6:00 PM — Final demos on the main stage (3-minute demo + 2-minute Q&A)
 6:00 – 6:30 PM — Winners announced, group photo and wrap-up

## Who should apply

 You have an ambitious idea and want to ship it this weekend, whether or not you write the code yourself
 You're a founder, engineer, product manager, designer, operator or business professional with 2+ years of experience
 You're pre-seed or pre-company and want a real shot at a YC interview
 You can be in San Francisco on October 24–25

## Why join

 Build inside YC's SF office alongside 175 equally driven people
 Get mentoring from teams who build AI products every day
 Win a prize that can change your trajectory: a direct YC interview

## How to apply

1. Fill out the application on this page
2. Tell us who you are, what you've built and what you want to build at VibeCon
3. Accepted builders get a confirmation email with everything they need to prepare
